findings.title: beforeExit is not final capture closure
findings.explanation: A legal later beforeExit listener schedules asynchronous business work. The collector already ended fd3 with incomplete:false/emitted0. Later waits increment emitted to2 and output-after-end marks incomplete:true, but the final state cannot reach fd3. Child still exits0 with clean stderr. A supervisor checking only terminal receipt/exit/stdio could falsely accept completeness.
findings.minimalNext: Only fix terminal receipt lifecycle: commit final receipt at a truly final, bounded publication boundary after pending observer writes are settled, or classify this beforeExit record as nonterminal and refuse completeness based on it. Add this one deterministic re-entry regression. Do not change the five await edits, cancellation, business errors, environment or tracing scope.

acceptedScope: R1 private callback/fd3 fault-containment implementation and its two green regressions may be preserved as uninstalled evidence. Do not accept the new beforeExit receipt as proof of complete capture or release service execution.

environment.blocker: macOS refuses sandbox_apply before true starts. Legitimate executor/environment capability resolution is required; no alternate path, relaxation or escalation is assigned. Even repaired receipt does not unblock Host.
